# Reserved File Frontmatter Constraint

Each reserved OKF filename may only include a frontmatter block with exactly the allowed top-level keys specified in its ReservedFileRule; if allowed_keys is empty, no frontmatter block is permitted.

To enforce consistent structure for special-purpose files, preventing drift and ensuring predictable parsing and rendering.
